options.name: Soque Greenway Trail
options.description: A relaxed riverside and wetland walk near downtown; formerly Clarkesville Greenways. The published Phase I loop is about half a mile; choose a short out-and-back rather than committing to every trail.
options.hours_note: No official opening/closing hours found; plan daylight only.
options.drive_estimate: 20–25 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Friday short-window option

options.review_note: No independently verified current review score; selection is based on documented setting and practical fit.

options.name: Historic downtown Clarkesville
options.description: Browse the compact historic center and independent shops, or combine the square with lunch. Individual shops keep their own hours; historic house interior tours are not assumed.
options.hours_note: Outdoor stroll: daylight recommendation, not a posted gate schedule. Mauldin House hours vary and tours are by appointment.
options.drive_estimate: 20–25 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Friday short-window option
options.review_note: No independently verified current review score; selection is based on documented setting and practical fit.

options.name: Mark of the Potter
options.description: Handmade ceramics in a scenic Soque River setting on Highway 197. A distinctive art-and-river stop, but not a downtown add-on in the same tight lunch timetable.
options.hours_note: Official site only posts SUMMER hours 10 am–6 pm daily; October hours remain unconfirmed.
options.drive_estimate: 35–45 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Save for a longer afternoon / weekend; reconfirm seasonal hours
options.photo_caption: Mark of the Potter riverside setting · representative photo
options.review_note: No independently verified current review score; selection is based on documented setting and practical fit.

options.name: Tallulah Gorge rim overlooks
options.description: Dramatic canyon and waterfall views from rim trails. Keep this as a dedicated longer-day option, not lunch plus a rushed gorge hike.
options.hours_note: Oct 23, 2026 is an official aesthetic water-release date (8 am–8 pm): gorge-floor hiking/climbing prohibited; southside staircase closed. Rim viewpoints are the relevant option. Check current park hours/alerts.
options.drive_estimate: 35–45 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Longer day / weekend; NOT the short Friday default
options.review_note: No independently verified current review score; selection is based on documented setting and practical fit.

options.name: The Copper Pot
options.description: A downtown lunch anchor at 135 Grant Street; convenient pairing with a short town stroll. Selected for location and character rather than an unverified mountain-view claim.
options.hours_note: Thu–Sun opens 11 am; last seating around 8:30 pm; kitchen closes 9 pm.
options.drive_estimate: 20–25 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Friday lunch option

options.description: Creek and river scenery, shady oaks, benches and easy-to-scale walking time. County lists 4.62 miles of trails in total; you need only a short section.

options.name: Historic Courthouse Museum & town square
options.description: Local-history exhibits inside the restored 1899 courthouse, with a compact town-square stroll outside. A useful indoor alternative if arrival is early enough.
options.hours_note: Official museum guide: 10 am–4 pm, Mon–Sat May–December; Mon–Fri January–April. Arrive well before 4 pm.

options.name: Brasstown Bald summit
options.description: Panoramic Blue Ridge views from Georgia’s highest summit. Shuttle is included in regular admission; walking route is a steep 0.6 mile each way from parking.
options.hours_note: Official visitor services daily 10 am–5 pm in season; last uphill shuttle 4:30, last return 5. $10/adult during regular hours. Weather can interrupt access.
options.drive_estimate: 40–50 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Save for a longer day / weekend; not the Friday short-window default

options.name: Cabin Coffee
options.description: Coffee and a light lunch on Blairsville’s town square; a convenient low-key stop before a walk. Not a mountain-view restaurant.
options.hours_note: Fri 7 am–4 pm; Sat 8 am–4 pm; Sun 8 am–2 pm. Official location page takes precedence over tourism listing showing 4:30 pm.
options.drive_estimate: 10–15 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: Friday only before 4 pm closing
options.review_note: No independently verified current review score; selection is based on documented setting and practical fit.

options.name: The View Grill at Butternut Creek
options.description: The strongest documented view-led dining lead: upstairs windows and patio face the golf course and North Georgia mountains. Save as a candidate, not a guaranteed-open stop.
options.hours_note: Chamber lists Tue–Sat 11 am–8 pm, but county records document a March 2026 operator change and other hours conflict. Current operation/hours need reconfirmation before relying on it.
options.drive_estimate: 10–15 min each way from airport (planning estimate, not live routing)
options.time_fit: View-led dining candidate; verify before Friday or a future trip
options.review_note: No reliable current post-operator-change review score established; do not label highly rated.

KAHN.name: Athens
KAHN.distance_basis: Planner value for KAVL/KGKT; other great-circle planning estimates

options.name: State Botanical Garden of Georgia
options.description: A gentle self-guided wander through themed display gardens; add woodland trails only when time allows.
options.hours_note: Grounds daily 7 am–7 pm except UGA holidays. Visitor center, museum and shop Tue–Sat 9 am–4:30 pm; Sun 11:30 am–4:30 pm; Mon closed.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → garden: allow 15–20 minutes each way (estimate).
options.time_fit: Best short-window choice: 60–90 minutes in the display gardens; indoor facilities close at 4:30 pm.
options.longer_fit: Allow 2–3 hours for more gardens, nature trails and the Porcelain and Decorative Arts Museum. The regular walk-up guided tour is Tue–Fri 11 am–noon, not afternoon.
options.photo_caption: Garden paths, representative green-season photograph; not current foliage.
options.photo_credit: State Botanical Garden of Georgia / UGA; photographer not identified
options.photo_rights: Source-owned; private reference preview only. No public reuse license verified.

options.name: Georgia Museum of Art
options.description: Explore selected galleries at your own pace, with an outdoor sculpture garden as a possible extra.
options.hours_note: Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat 10 am–5 pm; Thu 10 am–9 pm; Sun 1–5 pm; Mon closed.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → museum: allow 10–15 minutes each way (estimate), plus parking and walking.
options.time_fit: 45–75 minutes is a useful short visit before the 5 pm closing; reserve free timed tickets first.
options.longer_fit: Allow 1.5–2 hours for galleries and sculpture garden. Thursday stays open until 9 pm; Saturday 10–5 and Sunday 1–5 offer future-trip alternatives.

options.name: Historic North Campus + downtown
options.description: Start by the Arch and follow part of UGA’s self-guided map past historic campus landmarks, Herty Field and the Founders Memorial Garden.
options.hours_note: Outdoor self-guided route: no published gate hours found; plan for daylight. Visitor Center Mon–Fri 8 am–5 pm, selected Saturdays 9:30 am–3 pm; closed Sunday, UGA holidays and home-football Saturdays.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → downtown/Arch: allow 10–15 minutes each way (estimate), plus parking.
options.time_fit: 30–60 minute outdoor stroll pairs naturally with The Place across Broad Street; easiest food-and-walk combination.
options.longer_fit: Follow the full self-guided map and leave time for downtown shops. A scheduled campus visit is a separate two-hour registered experience.

options.name: Sandy Creek Nature Center
options.description: A quieter nature choice with woodland and wetland paths, wildlife observation areas and a short accessible interpretive trail.
options.hours_note: Trails daily sunrise–sunset. Education/visitor center Tue–Sat 8:30 am–5:30 pm; Sun/Mon closed.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → nature center: allow 15–20 minutes each way (estimate).
options.time_fit: 45–75 minute short trail or boardwalk wander; keep a firm turn-around time.
options.longer_fit: Allow 1.5–3 hours for more trails and indoor exhibits. Do not plan a through-walk to Sandy Creek Park: the park’s current trail page says that connection is not accessible.
options.photo_caption: Boardwalk-trail image from the nature center supporter website; representative conditions.
options.photo_credit: Friends of Sandy Creek Nature Center; photographer not identified
options.photo_rights: Source-owned; private reference preview only. No public reuse license verified.

options.name: The Place
options.description: Refined Southern comfort food in a renovated downtown space. The second floor overlooks historic North Campus; ask about a window table, but a view seat and upstairs service are not guaranteed.
options.hours_note: Mon–Thu 11 am–9 pm; Fri–Sat 11 am–10 pm; Sun brunch 10 am–2 pm and dinner 4–9 pm.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → The Place: allow 10–15 minutes each way (estimate).
options.time_fit: Good Friday lunch/late-lunch option. Allow 60–75 minutes plus any wait; pair with a short North Campus stroll rather than driving to a second distant stop.
options.longer_fit: Also suits Saturday lunch/dinner or Sunday brunch on a future visit.
options.photo_caption: Representative dish from The Place; current menu may differ.
options.photo_credit: The Place official website; photographer not identified
options.review_note: Tripadvisor search-indexed regional pages show 4.4/5; review count not verified. Treat this as an indexed snapshot, not a live verified rating.
options.photo_rights: Source-owned; private reference preview only. No public reuse license verified.

options.name: Last Resort Grill
options.description: An Athens restaurant in a former music-club setting, with Southern cooking influenced by the Southwest. A character choice rather than a confirmed scenic-view restaurant.
options.hours_note: Dinner daily from 5 pm; closing time not specified on official homepage. Brunch/lunch Sat–Sun 11 am–2 pm.
options.drive_estimate: KAHN → Last Resort: allow 10–15 minutes each way (estimate).
options.time_fit: Not for this short Friday afternoon: official site lists dinner starting at 5 pm, with lunch only on weekends.
options.longer_fit: Save for Saturday/Sunday brunch or a longer evening visit. Official site offers limited reservations and welcomes walk-ins; no booking made.
options.photo_caption: Representative plated dish beside a patio fire feature; not a guaranteed table or menu item.
options.photo_credit: MaggsLeePhoto with Keith P. Rein, credited on Last Resort Grill website
options.review_note: Tripadvisor fetched snapshot: 4.5/5 from 1,450 reviews. Rating and count may change; its Friday lunch hours conflict with the restaurant’s official site, which controls this plan.
options.photo_rights: Source-owned; private reference preview only. No public reuse license verified.

KCVC.name: Covington
KCVC.distance_basis: Planner value for KAVL/KGKT; other great-circle planning estimates

options.name: Historic square + Walk of Stars
options.description: A compact downtown stroll around the courthouse square: browse shops, spot familiar filming locations and follow star pavers celebrating films and TV productions. Self-guided and easy to shorten.
options.hours_note: Outdoor self-guided walk; no gate hours published. Plan for daylight; individual shops set their own hours.
options.photo_caption: An actual Walk of Stars pavement marker; representative photo, not current conditions.
options.photo_credit: Discover Covington GA official tourism website; photographer not identified. Source-owned image; no public-reuse license verified.
options.time_fit: Friday fit: 30–45 minutes; pair with lunch rather than a scheduled multi-hour tour.
options.drive_estimate: KCVC FBO → downtown square: allow 15–20 minutes each way (planning estimate, not live routing); the four downtown options are near one another.
options.longer_weekend: For a future half-day, use the self-guided TV/movie or historic-home brochures from the Welcome Center; view private homes from public areas only.

options.name: Welcome Center film + history exhibits
options.description: Browse film memorabilia and local-history displays at the Welcome Center, then walk the two blocks toward the square. A useful indoor stop without committing to a longer guided tour.
options.hours_note: Welcome Center Mon–Fri 9 am–5 pm; Sat 10 am–4 pm; Sunday closed. Regular hours from official tourism contact page; exceptional closures unconfirmed.
options.photo_caption: Welcome Center exhibit interior from the tourism site; representative photo dated March 2023 in source filename.
options.photo_credit: Discover Covington GA official tourism website; photographer not identified. Source-owned image; no public-reuse license verified.
options.time_fit: Friday fit: allow 20–40 minutes and arrive well before 5 pm. Optional addition, not required if lunch runs long.
options.drive_estimate: KCVC FBO → downtown square: allow 15–20 minutes each way (planning estimate, not live routing); the four downtown options are near one another.
options.longer_weekend: Saturday open 10–4; Sunday closed. Exhibition selection can change.

options.name: Mystic Grill
options.description: Southern food with a twist and a real rooftop overlooking Historic Covington Square. Strongest lunch-with-a-view choice here; rooftop seating is weather- and availability-dependent, not reserved or guaranteed.
options.hours_note: Mon–Thu and Sun 11 am–9 pm; Fri–Sat 11 am–10 pm. Official published hours.
options.photo_caption: Mystic Grill exterior, from its official tourism-directory listing; rooftop photo download was blocked.
options.photo_credit: Discover Covington GA official tourism website; photographer not identified. Source-owned image; no public-reuse license verified.
options.time_fit: Friday fit: allow 60–90 minutes including a modest wait. Rooftop lunch + a short square walk is the primary pairing.
options.drive_estimate: KCVC FBO → downtown square: allow 15–20 minutes each way (planning estimate, not live routing); the four downtown options are near one another.
options.review_note: Tripadvisor fetched snapshot: 4.4/5 from 840 reviews. Recent reviews include both praise for rooftop dining and complaints about value/food consistency; not a guarantee.
options.longer_weekend: Works for a future Saturday lunch or longer dinner visit too; restaurant is open all week.

options.name: Bread and Butter Bakery — Covington Square
options.description: A lighter, flexible alternative for sandwiches, pastries and specialty coffee in a brick storefront on the square. Choose this rather than a second full restaurant meal when ground time is tight.
options.hours_note: Covington Square location: Sun–Thu 7 am–9 pm; Fri–Sat 7 am–10 pm. These are café hours, not a guarantee every sandwich is available all day.
options.photo_caption: Bread and Butter storefront at the Covington Square location; representative tourism-directory photo.
options.photo_credit: Discover Covington GA official tourism website; photographer not identified. Source-owned image; no public-reuse license verified.
options.time_fit: Friday fit: allow 30–45 minutes for a light meal/coffee, plus any line. Shorter alternative to Mystic Grill.
options.drive_estimate: KCVC FBO → downtown square: allow 15–20 minutes each way (planning estimate, not live routing); the four downtown options are near one another.
options.review_note: Tripadvisor fetched snapshot: 4.3/5 from 83 reviews for the Square location; ratings and counts may change.
options.longer_weekend: Also a breakfast or dessert stop on a future visit. Do not confuse with the separate Hwy 278 drive-through location.
